关于校门口的故事(A Story about the school gate): 一篇关于校园生活的A2短文:莉莉与马克斯的经历和小计划。
Last Wednesday, Lily and Max went to the school gate. Lily wants to be a cook in the future. Lily usually has soup for breakfast. Teachers spend weekends on marking.
Life is full of small surprises. It takes twenty minutes to get to the school gate by bike. Lily learned a lot about English. The transfer news is still unofficial.
They took many photos at the teachers' office. The school gate is one of the best places in the city. Both of them like soup and tea. Also, the victorious team lifted the golden cup high.
Lily hopes to visit Chengdu one day. Lily and Max had great fun there. Lily bought a hat at the shop yesterday.
